svg.title: GRAPHIC 12.4 — Encoders Are Right, Heading Is Wrong
svg.desc: Top-down Zumo on a smooth slick floor. The wheels rotate as if making a 90 degree turn, but the robot heading stays nearly unchanged.
svg.text: GRAPHIC 12.4 — Encoders Are Right, Heading Is Wrong
The wheels turned like a 90° command, but the robot stayed pointed almost exactly where it started.
On a smooth, slick floor, the wheels can spin without enough grip to rotate the robot body.
